license_reconciliation.method: Applied scripts.scrapers.prose_plus_code.classify_pep_license to all 745 PEP .rst files (excluding pep-0000) and joined results to pilot records by document_id.
license_reconciliation.pep_1_evidence: PEP 1 requires a dual public-domain/CC0 license only for new PEPs; it does not establish a repository-wide license for all historical PEPs. The PEPs clone has no LICENSE file.
license_reconciliation.pilot_assertion: Every PEP record is stamped 'Public domain / CC0-1.0' at source level; 33 documents lack per-document support for that assertion.

reproducibility.byte_difference_reason: retrieved_at is wall-clock time at record construction; all other fields match.
reproducibility.conclusion: The pilot is content-deterministic. Byte-level reproducibility is not achievable without pinning or excluding retrieved_at.
reproducibility.method: Re-ran scripts.scrapers.prose_docs against read-only symlinks to the existing data/raw/{peps,devguide} clones. raw_root and stage1_root were under /tmp/opencode/prose_repro; no repository data path was written. Symlinks only exposed existing repo/ and ACQUISITION_MANIFEST.json files.

schema_contract.alias_caveat: exact_hash hashes rendered content including the '## section_path' header and '(part i/n)' marker; it is not a pure content hash and is not the global_dedup.normalized_hash contract for Python code.
schema_contract.global_dedup_contract: scripts/processors/global_dedup.py normalizes Python code (line endings, trailing whitespace, blank lines) and requires ProvenancePreserver.kept_source/discarded_sources. Neither pilot hash implements that normalized_hash contract, and the pilot does not emit dedup provenance.
schema_contract.quality_gate_note: scripts/quality_gate.py reads a top-level 'code' field; the prose schema exposes 'code_blocks' instead.
